origin.description: Whether cli should emit UTF-8 characters.
origin.details: cli.unicode TRUE or FALSE wins. Otherwise the locale encoding is UTF-8. LaTeX output is false; knitr is not loaded here, so that branch stays false.

translation.description: Whether cli should emit UTF-8 characters.
translation.details: cli.unicode TRUE or FALSE wins. Otherwise the locale encoding is UTF-8. LaTeX output is false; knitr is not loaded here, so that branch stays false.
translation.example:
from cli import is_utf8_output, options
options(**{"cli.unicode": True})
print(is_utf8_output())
